# Wisconsin local planning and commission records (2026-11-17)

Agendas, packets, staff reports and minutes posted since 2024-01-01 by the bodies around the GEM plants and the leads, searched for plant and developer names and for power and data center words. A record is a lead: open the document at its address and cite it there. Copies are in scopes/us-wi/work/local/ and are not committed.
